mapper.select: SELECT c.cls_stts_cd AS status,c.cls_at AS "processedAt",c.cls_user_id AS "actorId",u.user_nm AS "actorName" FROM fin.mth_cls c LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=c.cls_user_id WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}

SELECT c.cls_chk_cd AS code,c.chk_rslt_cd AS status,c.issue_cnt AS count,c.msg_desc AS description, c.chk_at AS "checkedAt" FROM fin.mth_cls_chk c LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id='CLOSE_CHECK' AND d.dtl_cd=c.cls_chk_cd WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month} ORDER BY d.sort_seq NULLS LAST,c.cls_chk_cd
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT count(*) FROM cst.prvmn_adj WHERE orgnl_ym=#{month} AND adj_stts_cd='ACTIVE'

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'allocation',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'labor',coalesce(sum(lbr_cst_amt),0), 'expenses',coalesce(sum(drct_expns_amt),0),'sales',coalesce(sum(sls_amt),0)) FROM cst.cst_aloc WHERE cst_ym=#{month}), 'profit',(SELECT to_jsonb(p)-'cnfrm_at'-'cnfrm_user_id'-'upld_id' FROM fin.mth_pl p WHERE p.pl_ym=#{month} AND p.pl_src_cd='CLOSE'), 'details',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'revenue',coalesce(sum(sls_amt),0), 'cost',coalesce(sum(cst_amt),0),'grossProfit',coalesce(sum(grs_prft_amt),0)) FROM fin.mth_pl_dtl WHERE pl_ym=#{month}), 'tax',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('amount',corp_tax_amt) FROM fin.corp_tax_mth WHERE tax_ym=#{month}), 'cash',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('opening',bgn_bal_amt,'closing',end_bal_amt) FROM fin.cash_bal WHERE bal_ym=#{month} AND bgn_bal_amt IS NOT NULL AND end_bal_amt IS NOT NULL) )::text
